notes.title: Blending a comedy visual novel with pachinko, Jump the Track adds Linux and macOS support
notes.content:
Jump the Track has a great visual style and a fun looking blend of a comedy visual novel with pachinko, and now it has Linux and macOS support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/blending-a-comedy-visual-novel-with-pachinko-jump-the-track-adds-linux-and-macos-support/

notes.title: Jump the Track on MacOS and Linux !
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/899c1b196e757c59799ef0f4324cf762aeb84835.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Steam, we have good news for the Mac and Linux players, the game is now available on these platforms! We have also made a full pass of rework on Steam Deck Compatibility, and it should run much smoother now.[/p][p]We hope that will let more people discover the game. Don't hesitate to hit us up, if there is a major issue with the new build.[/p][p]Cheers, and keep fighting the power![/p]

notes.title: Jump the Track is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/e57e9b8158a22fa4de221429ea0dacfccd935607.png[/img]

[h1]JUMP THE TRACK is OUT NOW[/h1]
The explosive comedy is out in the wild, ready to shake things up!
Hilarious and thought-provoking, the game will take you on a ridiculous adventure to fight for your life against the system ✊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/360cc7fa984d2c290a070694e6e8adad49bd5e0f.png[/img]

[h2]The chaotic merge of the visual novel and pachinko[/h2]
You play Sam, and his life is in danger. He'll embark on an unbelievable journey in his quest to replace the teddy bear. Meanwhile, a revolution breaks out in the city, fueled by the population’s anger towards the elite and oligarchy. 

Jump the Track is a frenetic story where all your possible choices get unlocked by playing arcade boards. The result? An adventure packed with action and surprise.

The game is quite short, but its story will not leave you indifferent. It’s a perfect choice if you're looking for a game to play in the evening. And of course, there are always new branches to explore if you want to replay it!

[h2]Things to know[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller: playable with mouse or gamepad 
[*] Price:  9,99€ or the equivalent in all currencies
[*] Duration: ~3h
[*] Languages available: English & French 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=ce8VkKx4SVM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The backstory[/h2]
Seed by Seed is an indie dev cooperative, which means: no boss, everyone has a voice, and everyone gets paid the same. After releasing Pile Up! Box by Box and Baladins, we started working on Jump the Track as the first SELF-PUBLISHED game. In the current industry, it has become very hard to fund and promote a game that is short, different, and has a political tone. 

To make this game, we had to go through a lot of difficulties. But the result is something very personal and dear to the team. Our survival as a studio is on the line with this release.

These are difficult times for indies, so any help is extremely appreciated 💖 Don't hesitate to share the love!

[h2]Support us by sharing the word[/h2]

notes.title: The DEMO is OUT
notes.content:
Hi Steam players, and Casino cheaters,
We're incredibly stoked to announce that the FIRST DEMO of Jump the Track is OUT!

Are you curious about our Visual Novel x Pachinko game chaotic emotional political narrative game? 
Well, this is the time to try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/21904f813eb0006283f7135785458acf4b5bd224.png[/img]

In this demo, you’ll dive into the world of gamblers and nightlife; welcome to the casino! You’re on the hunt for an old lady named Henriette who snagged something from a friend of yours. Watch out! She’s got plenty of tricks up her sleeve!

The demo last about 15 to 30 mins, is playable with mouse only and this is a solo game.
We hope you'll enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/9886d6aac6f1f9e5437f7a3bdc24fe6657261a71.jpg[/img]

This demo is out on the occasion of the Ludonarrracon 2025 event. Jump the Track is part of the official selection. Hype! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504190/31c1c5a5430e1a2db8274f602e896c64ff9d853e.png[/img]

LudoNarraCon is one of the greatest places on Steam to discover the finest narrative games. We highly recommend that you check it out.

At Seed by Seed, we're an indie cooperative and we're self-publishing this game, so don't hesitate to drop a wishlist to support us 💖🖤💖

Cheers from the team,
Keep raising against the system 💥

notes.title: Announcing JUMP THE TRACK
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946390]Jump the Track[/url]![/h2]

Hello Steam!
Our studio [b]Seed by Seed[/b], behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866320]Baladins[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109820]Pile Up! Box by Box[/url] is thrilled to announce its new game.

[b]Jump the Track is an explosive comedy that blends visual novel with pachinko. [/b]
You play Sam, a young dreamer struggling in the gig economy. Until tonight when everything changes. Fight your inner battles, rally your forces, and get ready to overthrow the system!

In this adventure game,[b] the choices you can make are determined by the arcade board [/b]representing your character's conflicting emotions. Your skill at play will determine the story's outcomes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145326/ac91a31677d2df6ad02c628cdff6a47025b4bff5.png[/img]

[h2]Watch the teaser![/h2]

[previewyoutube=Ze83x8JJV_o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coming early 2025[/b]
If you're curious, follow us and drop a wishlist to support the game <3

The Seed by Seed team
